message.content: In one of the discussions, GromHellscream suggests adding lanterns or string lights to the garden to brighten the area in the evening. This suggestion aims to create a magical atmosphere, especially suitable for community gatherings. Additionally, GromHellscream proposes considering solar-powered lanterns, which are described as eco-friendly and providing a lovely soft glow without any wiring hassles. Furthermore, GromHellscream recommends ensuring the lanterns’ styles complement the garden’s theme and its flowers.
